propositions: A single pathological pandoc input can hang the reconciler indefinitely because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, not pipe-holding grandchildren.

The DC renderer must invoke pandoc via subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True) with caller-side communicate(timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) and reap the whole process group via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired to kill spinning grandchildren.
On timeout or non-zero exit, each affected rendering unit degrades to its original Markdown verbatim without raising, leaving other units unaffected.
The pandoc binary delivery through pypandoc-binary==1.15 wheel must be pinned in pyproject.toml and verified in CI, with GPL provenance recorded in a new repo-root NOTICE file.
The timeout config key reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s (default 10s) must be reachable from config file and environment and documented.

Rendered output across the committed 178-body corpus (880 renderable units) must be byte-identical to the landed pre-hardening renderer, proving this story changes only robustness not rendering behavior.
